response.rationale: IgG4-related hypophysitis is strongly supported by elevated IgG4 with elevated IgG4/IgG ratio, diffuse pituitary-stalk swelling, hypopituitarism, and suspected systemic lung/sinus involvement. Lymphocytic hypophysitis shares pituitary swelling and hypopituitarism but lacks the systemic IgG4 signature.

A 7-mm poorly enhancing mass is atypical for lymphoma; elevated IgG4 and systemic pattern favor IgG4-related disease.
